messages:
sam: Quick poll: Im curating a 3-hour roadtrip mix (no pop hits). Suggestions for neo-jazz / downtempo that pair with an indie movie night?
olivia: Oh nice. Throw in some BadBadNotGood tracks + Nils Frahm for interludes.
devin: love BBNG. Add "Time Moves Slow" by BADBADNOTGOOD ft. Samuel T. Herring for a dusk drive vibe.
tasha: for indie movies, 'Paterson' or 'In the Mood for Love' (cheating, not indie) are perfect slow burners.
eno-bot: Playlist match suggestion: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3oZ3example (downtempo jazz / ambient) :headphones:
noah: also consider 'The Royal Tenenbaums' for quirky road-trip-adjacent scenes. more upbeat but cinematic.
sam: @olivia are you okay curating a two-hour backing mix and then we layer movie score stuff?
olivia: I can do a 2h backbone (neo-jazz -> lo-fi piano -> ambient) then hand off. will include some vinyl crackle textures.
devin: can we get a lightweight visual loop for intermission? 10min grainy film loop?
tasha: yes! i have a 10min VHS loop from an old festival set i can share.
sam: plan: drive mix (2h) + intermission loop (10m) + movie pairing. Sunday sunset run? 5pm meetup at the lot?
eno-bot: Event stub created: /events create "Sunset Mix & Drive" 1746088200 (Sunday 5pm local).
noah: RSVP: yes. bringing thermos of bad coffee.
devin: adding one wild card: some modern samba-jazz from Brazil for the middle stretch. mixes nicely with synth pads.
olivia: perfect. ill upload the playlist and share a short tracklist snippet: ```1. BADBADNOTGOOD - Time Moves Slow
2. Nils Frahm - Says (excerpt)
3. João Donato - Connection````
sam: love it. excited for the unlikely combo of neo-jazz + indie movie energy. low-key content night. :star2:
noah: can someone drop the Spotify URI so i can pre-download offline?
olivia: ```spotify:playlist:3oZ3example``` should work in the app.
tasha: bringing a tiny projector and a blanket fort. :tent:
sam: perfect. thanks team. this thread delivered more vibes than my whole week.
devin: same. also gif of cat driving to celebrate: :cat_drive:
eno-bot: Reminder set for participants at 1746084600 (1 hour before). :alarm_clock:
